annotations.title: File a Topic in a Room

description: Files one of the person's confirmed topics in a room: an existing room by room_id, or a new room by new_room_name. Takes effect immediately; nothing is reviewed. It files the topic, not the person. A topic that already has a room keeps it. A new room’s name is visible to every Famlore member in the room list.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

curiosity_id.description: A curiosity id the person owns that has a topic.

new_room_name.description: A name for a room that should exist but does not.

room_id.description: An existing room id. Omit if suggesting a new room.
